sources.location: Hub-and-spoke industrial real-time analytics reference workload
Microsoft Azure IoT analytics hub architecture supplied by the user

facts.claim: Connected vehicles, production equipment, and facility sensors emit operational telemetry.
IoT Hub, Event Hubs, and Stream Analytics form the streaming ingestion and preparation path.
Azure Synapse Analytics is modeled as the central analytical exchange for curated telemetry, historical context, and downstream insights.
Dashboards, operational applications, and automation consume distinct analytical products from the hub.
Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, and Foundry Models enrich the analytical hub with features, scores, and operational knowledge.
Identity, secrets, monitoring, security posture, and policy apply across the workload.
The supplied Microsoft reference anchors one high-degree analytical service between source and consumer towers, with enrichment below the hub.
Azure services use embedded official Microsoft architecture icons next to the represented product name.

assumptions: The diagram is a logical architecture rather than a regional or network deployment topology.
Azure Synapse Analytics is used as the analytical hub so the example can reuse a verified official icon already available in the repository.
External source glyphs are neutral illustrations rather than product logos.
